scripts.check: npm run generate:check && node packages/cli/bin/manko-ext.mjs check
scripts.test: npm run generate:check && node --test packages/cli/test/*.test.mjs packages/paperback-compat/*.test.mjs scripts/*.test.mjs extensions/content/*/tests/*.test.mjs extensions/tracker/*/tests/*.test.mjs
scripts.bundle: npm run generate && node packages/cli/bin/manko-ext.mjs bundle
scripts.publish:dry-run: npm run generate:check && node packages/cli/bin/manko-ext.mjs publish --dry-run
